items.title: Samsung's answer to Meta's Ray-Bans is (almost) here, with a little help from Google
items.excerpt: At Unpacked, Samsung previewed two Gemini-powered smart glasses built with Google, Warby Parker and Gentle Monster: non-display frames with cameras that let Gemini see and analyze your surroundings for live translation, navigation and notification summaries. Heavy workloads run on the paired Galaxy phone, a clear design bet on glasses-as-companion AI form factor for creatives and everyday users.

items.title: Samsung enters the AI glasses race with Gemini-powered Intelligent Eyewear and Android XR support
items.excerpt: Samsung's Intelligent Eyewear gives hands-free Gemini access for navigation, translation, messaging and note-taking - capture a whiteboard or meeting and have it auto-organized in Samsung Notes, with an eye-level camera, an LED privacy indicator and gesture control via a Galaxy Watch 9. A concrete look at how AI eyewear is being designed as an ambient capture-and-assist device.

items.title: Galaxy Watch 9 is 'Powered by Snapdragon Wear Elite,' leaked images confirm
items.excerpt: The Galaxy Watch 9 switches from Exynos to Qualcomm's Snapdragon Wear Elite, whose Hexagon NPU runs AI models with up to two billion parameters locally (~10 tokens/sec), enabling on-device Gemini and a Raise-to-Talk feature without a phone relay. A meaningful step for on-device AI on a mainstream wearable.

items.title: Everything announced at Samsung Unpacked 2026: three new foldables and two Galaxy Watches
items.excerpt: Engadget's hands-on recap of the July 22 London Unpacked: Z Fold 8 / Fold 8 Ultra / Flip 8 foldables, the Galaxy Watch 9 with new on-device AI health features and a Snapdragon Wear Elite chip, plus a brief look at Samsung's Snapdragon-AR1 AI glasses. Useful survey of where AI is landing across Samsung's 2026 hardware.

items.title: Leak reveals what to expect from Samsung's smart glasses at Unpacked tomorrow
items.excerpt: Pre-Unpacked spec leak for Samsung's Android XR glasses: a Snapdragon AR1 Gen 1 chip, ~9 hours of battery with a charging case, and AI-powered camera capabilities for Gemini-driven capture and assistance. Detail on the hardware powering Samsung's first mainstream AI eyewear.
